```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(ggplot2)
library(p8105.datasets)
data("ny_noaa")
```

```{r include=FALSE}
# Cleaning and tidying the dataset
ny_noaa_df = 
  ny_noaa |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  mutate(
    date = ymd(date),
    day = day(date),
    month = month(date),
    year = year(date)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    prcp = prcp / 10,
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10
  ) 
```

Column {data-width=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Boxplot: Snowfall distribution by year (since 2000)

```{r}
ny_noaa_df |>
  filter(snow > 0, snow < 100) |>
  mutate(year = factor(year)) |>
  plot_ly(y = ~ snow, color = ~year, 
          type = "box", colors = "viridis")
```

Column {data-width=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Average Maximum Temperature and Snow in January by Year  

```{r}
ny_noaa_df |>
  filter(month == 1) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarize(
    jan_tmax_average = mean(tmax, na.rm = TRUE),
    jan_snow_average = mean(snow, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~year, y = ~jan_tmax_average, type = "scatter", color = ~jan_snow_average, mode = "markers", alpha = 0.5, colors = "viridis"
  )
  
```
